Let's see: Ronald ancestor of Katherine, thus Ronald ancestor of Sandra and Joshua etc. So eventually Ronald is ancestor of Donna as well (since it's transitive). So Ronald is ancestor of Donna.

Also, Walter might be ancestor of Donna. So Donna's lineage goes upward to Ronald, Katherine, etc.

Now Cheryl: Matthew is ancestor of Cheryl. And we know Ronald is ancestor of Matthew. So Ronald is also ancestor of Cheryl.

Thus both Donna and Cheryl share a common ancestor (Ronald) but may be more direct.
